• Automated feed profiling for 40+ metadata providers across 10+ formats by building a pre-ingest DQ platform with Polars and DuckDB, eliminating manual validation before central pipeline ingestion.
  • Led migration of 50+ data pipeline scripts from CentOS to RockyOS, including Python 3.5→3.9 upgrades, Elasticsearch SSL auth, and dockerization of 6+ components; ensuring zero disruption to metadata pipelines serving 40+ providers.
  • Resolved 3 critical security vulnerabilities in the internal KGVT platform - including unrestricted API access, unauthenticated search endpoints enabling data scraping, and exposed system internals, by implementing Django-based session authentication and token-level API access controls.
  • Migrated 40+ production job notification pipelines from Slack to Microsoft Teams by building a Python wrapper over the PowerAutomate API with AdaptiveCards integration, replacing Slack SDK dependency across the entire data engineering notification infrastructure.

• Built a cross-cloud Resource Utilization Dashboard (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI) in Next.js and Highcharts, with interactive region → cluster → node → service drill-down; part of an initiative that drove $9M in YTD cost savings.
  • Implemented lazy-loaded tree views and SWR polling (15-min intervals) matched to Airflow’s ingestion cadence, avoiding upfront fetch of 600+ nodes and services across the 4 cloud providers.

• Built and enhanced metadata collection, enrichment, and processing pipelines for movies and episodes, improving throughput and reliability of delivery to 40+ downstream partner systems.
  • Cut data sync latency by 94% (72 hrs → 4 hrs) by redesigning the Python synchronization framework between Elasticsearch and MSSQL, removing bottlenecks in the metadata consistency layer.
  • Implemented a monitoring pipeline using Telegraf to collect Kafka consumer lag metrics from Burrow and visualize them in Splunk via interactive dashboards.
